review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one new definition, `physicalFrozenCoefficient`, at lines 53–57. It is a thin named specialization of the project's own `analyzingCoefficient` (defined in AnalyzingCoefficients.lean), with the packet area and frozen selector values `beta` plugged in. It is not a competing version of any Mathlib concept. `analyzingCoefficient` itself is a project-specific normalized L² pairing coefficient, and I found no matching Mathlib definition. `diagonalSynthesis` is likewise a local construct. The main theorem `analyzingCoefficient_l2_energy_le` is a weighted Bessel-type duality statement. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so I did not pursue that. The remaining theorems are proofs about local objects. The file defines no structures. The only related duplication I saw was that `physicalMultiplierCoefficient` appears in both PacketDataCoefficient.lean and SourceLabeledCoefficientSplit.lean. Neither is in the target file, and I did not check whether they share a namespace. Because `physicalFrozenCoefficient_eq_multiplier` is proved by `rfl`, the new name is compatible with the existing one, so I report no finding.
